author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect, rust-quality applied).** proto_blue_oauth::OAuthSession::refresh() handles DPoP-nonce-rotation internally — consume that primitive, don't rebuild the flow. Implementation: extend AtprotoOauthAuthVerifier with refresh_session(session_token) that loads sessions.refresh_token_enc, unseals via Crypto, deserializes DPoP keypair + refresh_token, builds OAuthSession with OAuthClient + DPoP key, calls .refresh(), re-seals the new token + (possibly rotated) DPoP keypair, UPDATE sessions row. New AuthError variants if needed for OAuth refresh failure. Test: insert sealed session, drive refresh against a wiremock token endpoint that returns DPoP-Nonce header, assert sessions row has updated bytes + last_seen_at.
